Welcome to the official SPCA of Northern Nevada YouTube Channel – we’re so glad you’re here! 🐾

We're a nonprofit, no-kill Adoption Center whose mission is to save and improve the lives of pets and people who love them. We strive to connect people and pets through adoption, accessible veterinary care, and community support. On our channel, you'll find heartwarming adoption stories, behind-the-scenes peeks at our lifesaving work, pet care tips, training how-tos, and updates on our low-cost clinic and spay/neuter services.

Subscribe and share with your fellow animal lovers so they can join the fun and help us make northern Nevada a more compassionate place for pets and their people! 💜
